name: v11.6.7
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: fall back to single transfers when hard links are denied by @kohjunhao in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1455
* fix: lock the sender's TotalSent reset by @bakirgdev in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1453
* feat: add OutDir option for library receivers by @bakirgdev in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1448
* fix: join every data room as a receiver with NoMultiplexing by @bakirgdev in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1452
* fix: relay config by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1457
* chore: update dependencies by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1458

## New Contributors
* @kohjunhao made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1455

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/schollz/croc/compare/v11.6.6...v11.6.7
